# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 R2 phases 1 to 3, the heirs of the Ilkhanate. Generated by gen_ilkhanate.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 26); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): close; then the books, the world steps (unless void), and at most one
# event in a calm, free month.
oe_ilk_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ilk_off } }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1411.1.1 }
            set_variable = oe_ilk_off
            debug_log = "oe_ilk: the line is closed"
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
            oe_ilk_books = yes
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ilk_void } } oe_ilk_world = yes }
            oe_ilk_events = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The books (design 3.3, no pop-up).
oe_ilk_books = {
    # the first run: the Jalayirid state is saved as a scope (vanilla may turn JAL into ILK; the scope follows it)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ilk_on } }
        set_variable = oe_ilk_on
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_jal } country_exists = c:JAL } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_jal value = c:JAL } }
    }
    # the author's Persian plan is done: from now on the player's campaigns rewrite this region, the world steps stop
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ilk_void } has_variable = oe_heg_persia_plan_done }
        set_variable = oe_ilk_void
        debug_log = "oe_ilk: the world steps are void (the Persian plan is done)"
    }
    # Timur has reached Azerbaijan (the Georgia line may read it)
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_timur_west }
            country_exists = c:TIM
            OR = { location:tabriz = { owner ?= c:TIM } location:soltaniyeh = { owner ?= c:TIM } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_timur_west value = 1 }
    }
    # the months since w7, while .1 is still open
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_bride_m NOT = { has_variable = oe_ilk_done_1 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ilk_bride_m add = 1 }
    }
    # phase 2: Ankara, first seen in 757-888 (1400-1410): Timur holds the Ottoman sultan (B3's own flag, or its
    # trigger where the interregnum could not begin; as N2's oe_bey_cap_seen). Then the months since (.3, w15).
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_ank_m }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ilk_ank_m add = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ilk_m >= 757 var:oe_ilk_m <= 888 OR = { has_variable = oe_ivr_captured oe_ivr_sultan_captured = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_ank_m value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk: Ankara seen in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
    }
}

        }
    }
    oe_ilk_w14_sum = yes
    # w15 The White Sheep get Diyarbakir (months 0-18 after Ankara; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w15 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_ank_m var:oe_ilk_ank_m <= 18 oe_ilk_w15_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w15 oe_ilk_w15_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w15 } OR = { AND = { has_variable = oe_ilk_ank_m var:oe_ilk_ank_m >= 18 } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ilk_ank_m } var:oe_ilk_m >= 888 } } }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w15_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w15 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w15 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w15 missed (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
        }
    }
    # w16 The Black Sheep return (months 838-888; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w16 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 838 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w16 } var:oe_ilk_m <= 888 oe_ilk_w16_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w16 oe_ilk_w16_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w16 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 888 }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w16_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w16 missed (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
        }
    }
    # w17 Kerman (months 37-60; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w17 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 37 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w17 } var:oe_ilk_m <= 60 oe_ilk_w17_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w17 oe_ilk_w17_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w17 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 60 }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w17_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w17 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w17 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w17 missed (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
        }
    }
    # w18 Togha Temur's death (months 203-210; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 203 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18 } var:oe_ilk_m <= 210 oe_ilk_w18_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w18 oe_ilk_w18_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 210 }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w18_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w18 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w18 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w18 missed (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
        }
    }
    # w19 Shiraz (months 198-252; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 198 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19 } var:oe_ilk_m <= 252 oe_ilk_w19_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w19 oe_ilk_w19_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 252 }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w19_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w19 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w19 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w19 missed (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
        }
    }
    # w20 Shah Shoja (months 258-270; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w20 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 258 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w20 } var:oe_ilk_m <= 270 oe_ilk_w20_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w20 oe_ilk_w20_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w20 } var:oe_ilk_m >= 270 }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w20_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w20 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w20 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w20 missed (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
        }
    }
    # w21k Herat (months 532-564; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k } var:oe_ilk_m >= 532 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k } var:oe_ilk_m <= 564 oe_ilk_w21k_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w21k oe_ilk_w21k_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k } var:oe_ilk_m >= 564 }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w21k_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w21k value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w21k value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w21k missed (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
        }
    }
    # w21s The Sarbadars (months 532-564; the chance is 100 / months left, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s } var:oe_ilk_m >= 532 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s } var:oe_ilk_m <= 564 oe_ilk_w21s_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_w21s oe_ilk_w21s_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s } var:oe_ilk_m >= 564 }
            if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w21s_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w21s value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w21s value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w21s missed (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
        }
    }
    oe_ilk_w21_sum = yes
}
# Any scope. w6 as one record, once both halves are settled: 1 at least one of the two confederations stands, 2 neither.
oe_ilk_w6_sum = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w6 } has_global_variable = oe_ilk_aqq has_global_variable = oe_ilk_qar }
        if = { limit = { OR = { OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_aqq global_var:oe_ilk_aqq = 1 } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_aqq global_var:oe_ilk_aqq = 6 } } OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_qar global_var:oe_ilk_qar = 1 } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_qar global_var:oe_ilk_qar = 6 } } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w6 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w6 value = 2 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events: lapse, then at most one while the lock is free, .3 before .2 before .1 (design 3.3).
# .1 and .2 wait for a calm month (their oe_ilk_ok_N); .3 does not.
oe_ilk_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_lapse_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_done_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_done_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_done_1 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ilk_pick = 0 oe_ilk_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ilk_pick = 0 oe_ilk_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ilk_pick = 0 oe_ilk_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_ilk_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ilk_pick = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_done_3 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ilk.3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ilk_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_done_2 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ilk.2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ilk_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_done_1 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ilk.1 }
        remove_variable = oe_ilk_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A world step runs: its effect and its record.
oe_ilk_w1_run = {
    oe_ilk_w1_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:HLG } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w1 value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w1 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w1 value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w1: the engine did not do it (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
}

# BYZ scope. w1 Soghurlugh (the battle of 15 June 1337; Musa Khan was put to death on 10 July): the Jalayirids
# put Musa Khan to death and annex his side (HLG) in the middle of the war HLG began.
# r19, probe 6: the annexation in the middle of the war works; whether the war then leaves the annexer's list is the
# first thing to look at in game (readout oe_ilk_rd_jal).
oe_ilk_w1_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:hlg_musa_khan exists = character:sfr_shaikh_ali_qushji }
	    if = {
	        limit = { character:hlg_musa_khan ?= { is_alive = yes } }
	        if = {
	            limit = { oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { has_ruler = yes } }
	            global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_jal_ruler } }
	            kill_character = { target = character:hlg_musa_khan reason = execution killer = scope:oe_ilk_jal_ruler }
	        }
	        else = { kill_character = { target = character:hlg_musa_khan reason = execution } }
	    }
	    # Shaikh Ali Qushji of Esfarayen, Musa's ally, died with him (who had him killed is told two ways: no killer).
	    if = {
	        limit = { country_exists = c:SFR c:SFR = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } character:sfr_shaikh_ali_qushji ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:SFR } }
	        kill_character = { target = character:sfr_shaikh_ali_qushji reason = execution }
	    }
	    global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { annex_country = { country = c:HLG reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
	}
}
# BYZ scope. w2 the Western merchants leave Tabriz (Genoa's boycotts of 1340 and 1342): the road by Tabriz and
# Trebizond thins out. No pop-up: the empire has no choice to make.
oe_ilk_w2_do = {
    location:tabriz = {
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tz }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ilk_franks_gone years = 20 mode = replace }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } location:trebizond = { owner ?= c:TRE } }
        location:trebizond = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ilk_caravans_thin years = 20 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { is_ai = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_ilk_tz } } }
        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_franks target = scope:oe_ilk_tz } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { is_ai = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_ilk_tz } } }
        c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_franks target = scope:oe_ilk_tz } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_tabriz_road value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. w3 Sutay changes hands (1343): Ibrahim Shah, backed by the Chobanids, kills Hajji Taghay and rules. The
# Sutayids leave the Jalayirids; they do not become Chobanid subjects (design 6.5).
oe_ilk_w3_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:sut_ibrahim_sah exists = character:sut_hajji_taghay }
	    c:SUT = { set_new_ruler = character:sut_ibrahim_sah }
	    if = {
	        limit = { character:sut_hajji_taghay ?= { is_alive = yes } }
	        kill_character = { target = character:sut_hajji_taghay reason = assassination killer = character:sut_ibrahim_sah }
	    }
	    if = {
	        limit = { oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { is_ai = yes } }
	        if = { limit = { c:SUT = { is_subject_of = global_var:oe_ilk_jal } } global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { cancel_subject = c:SUT } }
	        c:SUT = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_sut_jal target = global_var:oe_ilk_jal } }
	    }
	    c:SUT = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_sut_chb target = c:CHB } }
	    c:CHB = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_sut_chb target = c:SUT } }
	}
}
# BYZ scope. w4 Karanbuk (September-October 1343): Eretna defeats the army the Chobanids sent and rules as a sovereign
# from then on. global oe_ilk_w4_did: 1 freed of the Jalayirids + 10 the title of sultan + 100 Darende back.
oe_ilk_w4_do = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w4_did value = 0 }
    # 1 for the games in which vanilla's flavor_ere.1 never came: Eretna leaves its Jalayirid overlord without a war
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { is_ai = yes } c:ERE = { is_subject_of = global_var:oe_ilk_jal } }
        global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { cancel_subject = c:ERE }
        if = {
            limit = { c:ERE = { is_subject = no } }
            c:ERE = { add_truce_with = { target = global_var:oe_ilk_jal years = 5 mutual = yes } }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w4_did add = 1 }
        }
    }
    # 2 the victory
    c:ERE = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ilk_karanbuk years = 10 mode = replace }
        add_truce_with = { target = c:CHB years = 5 mutual = yes }
    }
    c:CHB = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_karanbuk target = c:ERE } }
    # 3 the title of sultan, where S8's own step has not given it: S8's effect and S8's own premise (free, below
    # kingdom rank), unless a human Eretna was asked and said no (oe_s8_w4 3 or 4). S8's record is left as it is.
    if = {
        limit = { c:ERE = { oe_s8_ev_4 = yes } NOT = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w4 global_var:oe_s8_w4 >= 3 } } }
        c:ERE = { oe_s8_sultan = yes }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w4_did add = 10 }
    }
    # 4 Darende, which S8's W-3 gave to Dulkadir, comes back to Eretna (after 1341; no war)
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_s8_w3 global_var:oe_s8_w3 = 1
            country_exists = c:DUL c:DUL = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:ERE } }
            location:darende = { owner ?= c:DUL controller ?= c:DUL has_siege = no is_capital = no }
        }
        location:darende = {
            change_location_owner = c:ERE
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_s8_darende_seized } remove_location_modifier = oe_s8_darende_seized }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:darende = { owner ?= c:ERE } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w4_did add = 100 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. w5 Hasan Kuchak dies at the end of 1343 (killed at Tabriz); Malek Ashraf takes the Chobanid throne.
oe_ilk_w5_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:chb_malek_ashraf exists = character:chb_hasan_kuchak }
	    if = {
	        limit = { character:chb_malek_ashraf ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } }
	        c:CHB = { set_new_ruler = character:chb_malek_ashraf }
	    }
	    if = {
	        limit = { character:chb_hasan_kuchak ?= { is_alive = yes } }
	        kill_character = { target = character:chb_hasan_kuchak reason = assassination }
	    }
	}
}
# BYZ scope. w6, The White Sheep (AQQ, capital palu): the owner X of palu gives the tag its home locations.
# r19, probe 1: a build from cores brought fewer than two locations. r20, probe 10: a location handed to a tag that
# is defined but not present wakes it, with a ruler. So the tag's cores are made sure of first (only where one is
# missing; vanilla flavor_chb.1 adds cores for the absent CHB the same way), and then every home location that X owns
# and that carries the tag's core is handed over, the capital first.
# Locations of third countries are not touched, nor X's own capital, nor a location under occupation or siege.
oe_ilk_aqq_do = {
    location:palu = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_x_aqq } }
    location:palu = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:AQQ } } add_core = c:AQQ } }
    location:harput = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:AQQ } } add_core = c:AQQ } }
    location:adakli = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:AQQ } } add_core = c:AQQ } }
    location:bayburt = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:AQQ } } add_core = c:AQQ } }
    location:palu = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:AQQ } change_location_owner = c:AQQ } }
    location:harput = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:AQQ } change_location_owner = c:AQQ } }
    location:adakli = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:AQQ } change_location_owner = c:AQQ } }
    location:bayburt = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:AQQ } change_location_owner = c:AQQ } }
}
# BYZ scope. The build and its self-check. Record oe_ilk_aqq: 1 the country stands with at least two locations (it then
# gets its chief Tur Ali, a truce of 5 years with X and its freedom), 5 it exists with fewer than two (failure: no
# chief, no truce, and w7 and .1 do not follow), 4 the engine built nothing.
oe_ilk_aqq_run = {
    oe_ilk_aqq_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ilk_aqq_two = yes }
        c:AQQ = {
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord ?= { cancel_subject = c:AQQ } }
            if = { limit = { location:palu = { owner ?= c:AQQ is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:palu }
            every_owned_location = { change_control = control_radical_bonus }
            every_province = {
                limit = { any_location_in_province = { NOT = { integration_level = core } } }
                change_province_integration = core
            }
            create_character = {
                first_name = oe_ilk_name_tur_ali
                female = no
                age = 45
                culture = culture:azeri_culture
                religion = religion:sunni
                estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                script = oe_ilk_tur_ali
                save_scope_as = oe_ilk_chief_aqq
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_chief_aqq } }
                create_character = {
                    first_name = oe_ilk_name_tur_ali
                    female = no
                    age = 45
                    culture = culture:azeri_culture
                    religion = religion:sunni
                    estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                    save_scope_as = oe_ilk_chief_aqq
                }
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_chief_aqq } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_ilk_chief_aqq }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq } } add_truce_with = { target = scope:oe_ilk_x_aqq years = 5 mutual = yes } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_aqq value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step aqq: AQQ built in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_aqq value = 5 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step aqq: AQQ exists with fewer than 2 locations, failure code 5 (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_aqq value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step aqq: the engine built no AQQ, failure code 4 (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
}
# BYZ scope. w6, The Black Sheep (QAR, capital ercis): the owner X of ercis gives the tag its home locations.
# r19, probe 1: a build from cores brought fewer than two locations. r20, probe 10: a location handed to a tag that
# is defined but not present wakes it, with a ruler. So the tag's cores are made sure of first (only where one is
# missing; vanilla flavor_chb.1 adds cores for the absent CHB the same way), and then every home location that X owns
# and that carries the tag's core is handed over, the capital first.
# Locations of third countries are not touched, nor X's own capital, nor a location under occupation or siege.
oe_ilk_qar_do = {
    location:ercis = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_x_qar } }
    location:ercis = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
    location:bargiri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
    location:qayyarah = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
    location:tal_afar = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
    location:ercis = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
    location:bargiri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
    location:qayyarah = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
    location:tal_afar = { if = { limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar controller ?= scope:oe_ilk_x_qar has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
}
# BYZ scope. The build and its self-check. Record oe_ilk_qar: 1 the country stands with at least two locations (it then
# gets its chief Bayram Khoja, a truce of 5 years with X and its freedom), 5 it exists with fewer than two (failure: no
# chief, no truce, and w7 and .1 do not follow), 4 the engine built nothing.
oe_ilk_qar_run = {
    oe_ilk_qar_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ilk_qar_two = yes }
        c:QAR = {
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord ?= { cancel_subject = c:QAR } }
            if = { limit = { location:ercis = { owner ?= c:QAR is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:ercis }
            every_owned_location = { change_control = control_radical_bonus }
            every_province = {
                limit = { any_location_in_province = { NOT = { integration_level = core } } }
                change_province_integration = core
            }
            create_character = {
                first_name = oe_ilk_name_bayram_khoja
                female = no
                age = 35
                culture = culture:azeri_culture
                religion = religion:sunni
                estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                script = oe_ilk_bayram_khoja
                save_scope_as = oe_ilk_chief_qar
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_chief_qar } }
                create_character = {
                    first_name = oe_ilk_name_bayram_khoja
                    female = no
                    age = 35
                    culture = culture:azeri_culture
                    religion = religion:sunni
                    estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                    save_scope_as = oe_ilk_chief_qar
                }
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_chief_qar } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_ilk_chief_qar }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_ilk_x_qar } } add_truce_with = { target = scope:oe_ilk_x_qar years = 5 mutual = yes } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_qar value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step qar: QAR built in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:QAR }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_qar value = 5 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step qar: QAR exists with fewer than 2 locations, failure code 5 (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_qar value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step qar: the engine built no QAR, failure code 4 (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
    }
}
# BYZ scope. w7 a bride for the White Sheep (1352): Trebizond makes peace with the Aq Qoyunlu by a marriage. No
# character is made and no real marriage: opinions and a truce. The months since are counted for .1.
oe_ilk_w7_do = {
    c:TRE = {
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_bride target = c:AQQ }
        add_truce_with = { target = c:AQQ years = 10 mutual = yes }
    }
    c:AQQ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_bride target = c:TRE } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_bride_m value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_ilk_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
# BYZ scope. Opinions of the empire ($m$ = the opinion), each only while that country is there.
oe_ilk_tre_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TRE } c:TRE = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}
oe_ilk_aqq_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ } c:AQQ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs). Not for options or actions.
oe_ilk_log = { debug_log = "oe_ilk m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_m')|0] world=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0] w4=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w4')|0] jal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_jal')|0] tabriz=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_tabriz')|0] road=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_road')|0] .1=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_done1')|0] bride=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_bride')|0] bm=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_bm')|0] tw=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tw')|0] void=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_void')|0]" }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. What every test button does first: the month, and the Jalayirid scope if the line has never run.
oe_ilk_test_begin = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_jal } country_exists = c:JAL } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_jal value = c:JAL } }
}
# BYZ scope. Run a world step now: the date is ignored, the AI and the premise are still checked.
oe_ilk_test_w1 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w1 } debug_log = "oe_ilk test: w1 is already recorded (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w1_ok = yes } oe_ilk_w1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: w1 cannot run now (a player or the imperial bloc involved, a missing country or character, or a war)" }
}

# BYZ scope. The next world step that has no record yet (the date ignored, the premise checked).
oe_ilk_test_next = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w1 } } oe_ilk_test_w1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w2 } } oe_ilk_test_w2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w3 } } oe_ilk_test_w3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w4 } } oe_ilk_test_w4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w5 } } oe_ilk_test_w5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_aqq } } oe_ilk_test_aqq = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_qar } } oe_ilk_test_qar = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w7 } } oe_ilk_test_w7 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: every world step of phase 1 is on record (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])" }
}
# BYZ scope. The alternative of w1 (design 6.4; generator switch W1_ANNEX = False): Musa Khan is only put to death and
# his side lives on. For the in-game comparison with the annexation.
oe_ilk_test_w1x = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:hlg_musa_khan exists = character:sfr_shaikh_ali_qushji }
	    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
	    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w1 } debug_log = "oe_ilk test: w1 is already recorded (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0]); reset first" }
	    else_if = {
	        limit = { oe_ilk_w1_who = yes character:hlg_musa_khan ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:HLG } }
	        if = {
	            limit = { character:hlg_musa_khan ?= { is_alive = yes } }
	            if = {
	                limit = { oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { has_ruler = yes } }
	                global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_jal_ruler } }
	                kill_character = { target = character:hlg_musa_khan reason = execution killer = scope:oe_ilk_jal_ruler }
	            }
	            else = { kill_character = { target = character:hlg_musa_khan reason = execution } }
	        }
	        # Shaikh Ali Qushji of Esfarayen, Musa's ally, died with him (who had him killed is told two ways: no killer).
	        if = {
	            limit = { country_exists = c:SFR c:SFR = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } character:sfr_shaikh_ali_qushji ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:SFR } }
	            kill_character = { target = character:sfr_shaikh_ali_qushji reason = execution }
	        }
	        if = { limit = { NOT = { character:hlg_musa_khan ?= { is_alive = yes } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w1 value = 1 } }
	        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w1 value = 4 } }
	        debug_log = "oe_ilk test: w1 without the annexation (world [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_a')|0] sheep [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_sheep')|0] home [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_home')|0])"
	    }
	    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: w1 (execution only) cannot run now" }
	}
}
# Any scope. Test preparation for w3, w4 and w5, which need the Chobanids: vanilla's flavor_chb.1 (1338-1343, 5% a
# month for the Jalayirids) is sent to JAL now. It builds CHB around Tabriz when Hasan Kuchak lives and JAL holds tabriz.
oe_ilk_test_chb = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:JAL NOT = { country_exists = c:CHB } }
        c:JAL = { trigger_event_non_silently = flavor_chb.1 }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: JAL is gone or CHB is there already" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .1 now: w7 runs first if it can (date ignored); when it cannot, its result is recorded for the text
# only and nothing in the world changes. The wait, the tie with Trebizond, calm and the lock are left out.
oe_ilk_test_1 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w7 } oe_ilk_w7_ok = yes } oe_ilk_w7_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ilk_ran_w7 = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w7 value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_bride_m value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk test: w7 could not run as a world step; its result was recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_ev_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_done_1 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ilk.1 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: .1 cannot be shown (Trebizond or the White Sheep are not there; build AQQ first)" }
}

# ================================================================ phase 2 "大不里士易主与帖木儿" (1357-1410)
# BYZ scope. A world step of phase 2 runs: its effect and its record (1; 4 the engine did not do it).
oe_ilk_w8_run = {
    oe_ilk_w8_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { character:chb_malek_ashraf ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w8 value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w8 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w8 value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w8: the engine did not do it (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
    }
}
oe_ilk_w9_run = {
    oe_ilk_w9_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:CHB } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w9 value = 1 } oe_ilk_w9_after = yes
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w9 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w9 value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w9: the engine did not do it (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
    }
}
oe_ilk_w10_run = {
    oe_ilk_w10_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { c:QAR = { is_subject_of = global_var:oe_ilk_jal } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w10 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w10_how value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w10 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
    }
    else = {
        c:QAR = { add_truce_with = { target = global_var:oe_ilk_jal years = 10 mutual = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_mush target = global_var:oe_ilk_jal } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w10 value = 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w10_how value = 2 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w10: no vassal (the engine refused); truce and opinion only (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
    }
}

# BYZ scope. w8 Jani Beg comes south (1357): the khan of the Golden Horde takes Tabriz and has Malik Ashraf put to
# death; the Chobanids are left leaderless. Before the Golden Horde line's W5 (Jani Beg's death, from 1357.7).
oe_ilk_w8_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:chb_malek_ashraf exists = character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin }
	    if = {
	        limit = { character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes } }
	        kill_character = { target = character:chb_malek_ashraf reason = execution killer = character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin }
	    }
	    else = { kill_character = { target = character:chb_malek_ashraf reason = execution } }
	    c:CHB = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ilk_leaderless years = 5 mode = replace } }
	}
}
# BYZ scope. w9 the Jalayirids take Tabriz (1358-1360, made one step; design 3.5 note 2): a peaceful annexation of the
# Chobanids. Their subjects are counted first (global oe_ilk_w9_subs) for the in-game check of what becomes of them;
# nothing of this line depends on it (brief B6).
oe_ilk_w9_do = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w9_subs value = 0 }
    c:CHB = { every_subject = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w9_subs add = 1 } } }
    global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { annex_country = { country = c:CHB reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope. After w9: the Jalayirids are seated at Tabriz and style themselves sultans (title marker oe_ilk_jal_sultan,
# read by gen_rank_titles.py); where they hold Tabriz the Franks' road there opens again in part.
oe_ilk_w9_after = {
    global_var:oe_ilk_jal = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ilk_tabriz_seat years = 10 mode = replace }
        set_variable = oe_ilk_jal_sultan
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:tabriz = { owner ?= global_var:oe_ilk_jal } }
        location:tabriz = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_ilk_franks_gone } remove_location_modifier = oe_ilk_franks_gone } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_tabriz_road value = 2 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. w10 the battle of Mush (1366; the vassalage "about 1375"): the Black Sheep become the Jalayirids' vassal.
oe_ilk_w10_do = {
    c:QAR = { make_subject_of = { target = global_var:oe_ilk_jal type = subject_type:vassal } }
}
# BYZ scope. w11 Tokhtamysh sacks Tabriz (winter 1385-86): looted for 5 years; its lord thinks ill of the Golden Horde.
oe_ilk_w11_do = {
    location:tabriz = {
        owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tz }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace }
    }
    scope:oe_ilk_tz = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_tabriz_sack target = c:GLH } }
}
# BYZ scope. w12 guests in Cairo (1393-1395): the Jalayirid sultan flees Timur to the Mamluks; only opinions (no
# alliance, no claim on anyone).
oe_ilk_w12_do = {
    global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_cairo target = c:MAM } }
    c:MAM = {
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_cairo target = global_var:oe_ilk_jal }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_envoy target = c:TIM }
    }
    if = { limit = { c:TIM = { is_ai = yes } } c:TIM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_envoy target = c:MAM } } }
}
# BYZ scope. w13 Burhan al-Din's death and Sivas (1398-99): the White Sheep's chief takes and kills the sultan of Sivas
# (vanilla's runtime character ere_burhan_al_din, when he rules), and Eretna's land bows to the Ottomans. Not given
# back after Ankara (design 3.5 note 4). Global oe_ilk_w13_burhan 1 when he was put to death here.
oe_ilk_w13_do = {
    if = {
        limit = { character:ere_burhan_al_din ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:ERE } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ c:AQQ = { has_ruler = yes } }
            c:AQQ = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_aqq_ruler } }
            kill_character = { target = character:ere_burhan_al_din reason = execution killer = scope:oe_ilk_aqq_ruler }
        }
        else = { kill_character = { target = character:ere_burhan_al_din reason = execution } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w13_burhan value = 1 }
    }
    c:ERE = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:vassal } }
    if = { limit = { c:ERE = { is_subject_of = c:TUR } } c:ERE = { set_variable = { name = oe_ilk_ere_sub value = 1 } } }
}
# BYZ scope. w14 Timur's storm (1400-01), three parts with their own records: a Sivas is sacked; b Aleppo and Damascus
# are sacked while Timur fights the Mamluks; c the exiles (the Jalayirid sultan, the Black Sheep's chief) are with the
# Ottomans and Timur and the sultan fall out over them (global oe_ilk_refugees). No war is opened.
oe_ilk_w14a_do = { location:sivas = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } } }
oe_ilk_w14b_do = {
    location:aleppo = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } } }
    location:damascus = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } } }
}
oe_ilk_w14c_do = {
    c:TIM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_refugees target = c:TUR } }
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_refugees target = c:TIM } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_refugees value = 1 }
}
# Any scope. w14 as the design's one three-digit record, once its three parts are settled.
oe_ilk_w14_sum = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w14 } has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w14a has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w14b has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w14c }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w14 value = oe_ilk_w14_val }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. w15 the White Sheep get Diyarbakir (1402-03): Diyarbakir and Ergani go from Timur's hand to the White Sheep,
# who move their seat to Diyarbakir; where Timur holds neither, only his favour (global oe_ilk_w15_how 1 land, 2 favour).
oe_ilk_w15_do = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w15_how value = 2 }
    location:diyarbekir = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:AQQ set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w15_how value = 1 } } }
    location:ergani = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:AQQ set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w15_how value = 1 } } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w15_how global_var:oe_ilk_w15_how = 1 }
        c:AQQ = { if = { limit = { location:diyarbekir = { owner ?= c:AQQ is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:diyarbekir } }
    }
    else = { c:AQQ = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ilk_timur_favour years = 10 mode = replace } } }
}
# BYZ scope. w16 the Black Sheep return (1406-1410, after Timur's death): Timur's state lets them go, or gives back
# the land of a confederation that is gone. Record oe_ilk_w16: 1 done (oe_ilk_w16_how 1 freed, 2 rebuilt), 4 the engine
# did not do it, 5 rebuilt with fewer than two locations (no chief, no truce: as w6).
oe_ilk_w16_run = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:QAR c:QAR = { is_subject_of = c:TIM } }
        c:TIM = { cancel_subject = c:QAR }
        if = {
            limit = { c:QAR = { is_subject = no } }
            c:QAR = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TIM years = 10 mutual = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16_how value = 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w16: the Black Sheep freed from Timur in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16 value = 4 }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w16: the Black Sheep are still Timur's subject, failure code 4 (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:QAR } }
        location:ercis = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
        location:bargiri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
        location:qayyarah = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
        location:tal_afar = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:QAR } } add_core = c:QAR } }
        location:ercis = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
        location:bargiri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
        location:qayyarah = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
        location:tal_afar = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TIM controller ?= c:TIM has_siege = no is_capital = no is_core_of = c:QAR } change_location_owner = c:QAR } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ilk_qar_two = yes }
            c:QAR = {
                if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord ?= { cancel_subject = c:QAR } }
                if = { limit = { location:ercis = { owner ?= c:QAR is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:ercis }
                every_owned_location = { change_control = control_radical_bonus }
                every_province = {
                    limit = { any_location_in_province = { NOT = { integration_level = core } } }
                    change_province_integration = core
                }
                change_government_type = government_type:tribe
                change_culture = culture:azeri_culture
                change_religion = religion:sunni
                set_court_language = dialect:azeri_dialect
                create_character = {
                    first_name = oe_ilk_name_qara_yusuf
                    female = no
                    age = 50
                    culture = culture:azeri_culture
                    religion = religion:sunni
                    estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                    script = oe_ilk_qara_yusuf
                    save_scope_as = oe_ilk_chief_w16
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_chief_w16 } }
                    create_character = {
                        first_name = oe_ilk_name_qara_yusuf
                        female = no
                        age = 50
                        culture = culture:azeri_culture
                        religion = religion:sunni
                        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                        save_scope_as = oe_ilk_chief_w16
                    }
                }
                if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_chief_w16 } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_ilk_chief_w16 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TIM } } add_truce_with = { target = c:TIM years = 10 mutual = yes } }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16_how value = 2 }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w16: the Black Sheep rebuilt in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:QAR }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16 value = 5 }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w16: QAR exists with fewer than 2 locations, failure code 5 (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w16 value = 4 }
            debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w16: the engine woke no QAR, failure code 4 (world_b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b')|0] b2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_b2')|0] w14 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w14')|0] how [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how')|0])"
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_ilk.90 (options set oe_ilk_do and send it; heavy effects never sit in an option).
# 1 = .3 a: the Ottoman soldiers stranded in Asia.
oe_ilk_do_job = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ilk_do ?= 1 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = yes } } c:TUR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ilk_stranded years = 5 mode = replace } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_do } remove_variable = oe_ilk_do }
}
# BYZ scope. Gain $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_ilk_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
# BYZ scope. Timur's / the Ottomans' opinion of the empire ($m$ = the opinion), only while that country is there.
oe_ilk_tim_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TIM } c:TIM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}
oe_ilk_tur_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}

# Any scope. Test preparation: Timur's state (TIM) for a 1337 test game, so that .2, .3, w12, w14 and w15 have a Timur
# to read. Phase 3 (r21: after the handover alone w15 still found no TIM; an army-type country seems to need troops to
# count as existing): the stand-in of oe_ilk_test_tim_build first, then Soltaniyeh and Ergani are handed over as before,
# where an AI outside the imperial bloc owns them and neither is a capital.
oe_ilk_test_tim = {
    oe_ilk_test_tim_build = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TIM }
        location:soltaniyeh = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes is_capital = no owner = { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no NOT = { tag = TIM } } } change_location_owner = c:TIM } }
        location:ergani = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes is_capital = no owner = { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no NOT = { tag = TIM } } } change_location_owner = c:TIM } }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk test: TIM is there; Soltaniyeh and Ergani handed to it where an AI held them"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: TIM could not be built (samarkand has no AI owner outside the imperial bloc, or the build failed)" }
}
# Any scope. Test preparation for w8: Jani Beg rules the Golden Horde now (the Golden Horde line's W3 does the same).
oe_ilk_test_jani = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin }
	    if = {
	        limit = { country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } }
	        c:GLH = { set_new_ruler = character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin }
	    }
	    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: the Golden Horde is gone or Jani Beg cannot take its throne" }
	}
}

        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w18 value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w18: the engine did not do it (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
    }
}
oe_ilk_w19_run = {
    oe_ilk_w19_do = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:INJ } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w19 value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w19 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_ilk_m').GetValue|0] (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
    }

    oe_ilk_w21k_do = yes

    }
    else = {
        c:KRT = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TIM years = 10 mutual = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ilk_bw_khorasan target = c:TIM } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w21k value = 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w21k_how value = 2 }
        debug_log = "oe_ilk world step w21k: no vassal (the engine refused); truce and opinion only (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])"
    }
}

# BYZ scope. w17 Kerman (1340): Mubariz al-Din of the Muzaffarids takes Kerman; here a peaceful annexation. Kerman's
# subjects are counted first (global oe_ilk_w17_subs; none of them is a player's or the bloc's).
oe_ilk_w17_do = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w17_subs value = 0 }
    c:KRM = { every_subject = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w17_subs add = 1 } } }
    c:MZF = { annex_country = { country = c:KRM reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope. w18 Togha Temur's death (December 1353): the last khan of Gurgan is murdered by the Sarbadars, who gain
# prestige. No killer is named (who struck the blow is told several ways).
oe_ilk_w18_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:grg_togha_temur }
	    kill_character = { target = character:grg_togha_temur reason = assassination }
	    c:SRB = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
	}
}
oe_ilk_w18_after = {
    # Gurgan's claim to the Ilkhanate goes with Togha Temur (design 6.11; W18_CLAIMANT). oe_ilk_w18_claim: 1 taken, 2 it
    # had none, 4 the engine left it.
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ilk_grg_claims = yes }
        international_organization:ilkhanate = { international_organization_remove_special_status = { type = special_status:ilkhan_claimant country = c:GRG } }
        if = { limit = { oe_ilk_grg_claims = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w18_claim value = 4 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w18_claim value = 1 } }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w18_claim value = 2 } }
}
# BYZ scope. w19 Shiraz (1353-1357, no year named): the Muzaffarids take Shiraz and Isfahan from the Injuids; here a
# peaceful annexation (design 5.1: the strong route's Persian branch reads oe_ilk_w19). The Injuids' subjects are counted
# first (global oe_ilk_w19_subs; nothing depends on what becomes of them).
oe_ilk_w19_do = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w19_subs value = 0 }
    c:INJ = { every_subject = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w19_subs add = 1 } } }
    c:MZF = { annex_country = { country = c:INJ reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope. w20 Shah Shoja (1358): the son takes his father's throne. The father was blinded and kept prisoner and died
# in 1363: he is not killed here (design).
oe_ilk_w20_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:mzf_shah_shoja }
	    c:MZF = { set_new_ruler = character:mzf_shah_shoja }
	}
}
# BYZ scope. w21 Herat (1381-1383): the Kartids of Herat bow to Timur; a former overlord, Gurgan, lets them go
# first (W21_SUBJECT).
oe_ilk_w21k_do = {
    if = { limit = { c:KRT = { is_subject_of = c:GRG } } c:GRG = { cancel_subject = c:KRT } }
    c:KRT = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TIM type = subject_type:vassal } }
}
# BYZ scope. w21 The Sarbadars (1381-1383): the Sarbadars bow to Timur; a former overlord, Gurgan, lets them go
# first (W21_SUBJECT).
oe_ilk_w21s_do = {
    if = { limit = { c:SRB = { is_subject_of = c:GRG } } c:GRG = { cancel_subject = c:SRB } }
    c:SRB = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TIM type = subject_type:vassal } }
}
# Any scope. w21 as one record (k + 10 s), once its two parts are settled.
oe_ilk_w21_sum = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21 } has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ilk_w21 value = oe_ilk_w21_val }
    }
}

    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: w17 cannot run now (a player or the imperial bloc involved, a missing country or character, or a war)" }
}

    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: every world step of phase 3 is on record (world_c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_world_c')|0] w21 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_w21')|0] how3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_how3')|0])" }
}
# Any scope. A STAND-IN for Timur's state, for throw-away test games only (the Georgia line's oe_geo_test_tim, seen
# working in r21, P4): in a 1337 game TIM does not exist (vanilla flavor_tim.8 founds it from 1360). Samarkand becomes a
# core of TIM, twelve horse archers are made for TIM there (an army-type country seems to need troops to count as
# existing), and the country is built from the core its owner holds. It gets whatever ruler the engine gives it, not
# Timur. Nothing when TIM exists already, or samarkand has no AI owner outside the imperial bloc.
oe_ilk_test_tim_build = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:TIM } location:samarkand = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no } } }
        location:samarkand = {
            owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tm_from }
            add_core = c:TIM
            while = {
                count = 12
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_steppe_horse_archers owner = c:TIM }
            }
        }
        scope:oe_ilk_tm_from = { create_country_from_cores_in_our_locations = c:TIM }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TIM } debug_log = "oe_ilk test: stand-in Timurids built at Samarkand" }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test: the stand-in Timurids were NOT built" }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. TEST PREPARATIONS (brief B12): each builds the premise of a step as a stand-in that CHANGES THE WORLD (troops,
# a location handed over, a capital moved, the stand-in Timurids, Timur killed, a war declared), for throw-away test
# games only; then it writes to the log whether the step's premise holds now. Records are not touched.
oe_ilk_test_p9 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_ran_w8 = no } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w9: w8 has not run yet (ilkchb, wait for vanilla's event, ilkw5, ilk2jani, ilk2w8)" }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHB c:CHB = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHB c:CHB = { is_subject = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no } } } c:CHB = { overlord = { cancel_subject = c:CHB } } }
        global_var:oe_ilk_jal = {
            save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_c
            while = {
                count = 30
                if = { limit = { army_size < oe_ilk_chb_army } capital = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_c } } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { is_neighbor_of = c:CHB } } c:CHB = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
            global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_a }
            c:CHB = { random_owned_location = { limit = { is_capital = no has_siege = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_a } }
        }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w9: the Chobanids or the Jalayirids are not there (ilkchb first)" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w9_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w9 is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w9 is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
}
oe_ilk_test_p10 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_qar_stands = no } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w10: the Black Sheep do not stand (ilkw6q first)" }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } c:QAR = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
        global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_j }
        # Tabriz is the Jalayirids' after w9; where it is not, it is handed to them (its owner's capital moved first)
        if = { limit = { NOT = { location:tabriz = { owner ?= scope:oe_ilk_tp_j } } } if = {
            limit = { location:tabriz = { has_owner = yes has_siege = no owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_ilk_tp_j } } } }
            location:tabriz = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_o } }
            if = {
                limit = { location:tabriz = { is_capital = yes } }
                scope:oe_ilk_tp_o = {
                    random_owned_location = { limit = { NOT = { this = location:tabriz } has_siege = no } save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_cap_tabriz }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_tabriz } set_capital = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_tabriz }
                }
            }
            location:tabriz = { if = { limit = { is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_j } }
        } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:QAR c:QAR = { is_subject = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no } } } c:QAR = { overlord = { cancel_subject = c:QAR } } }
        global_var:oe_ilk_jal = {
            save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_c
            while = {
                count = 30
                if = { limit = { army_size < oe_ilk_qar_army_x2 } capital = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_c } } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { is_neighbor_of = c:QAR } } c:QAR = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
            global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_a }
            c:QAR = { random_owned_location = { limit = { is_capital = no has_siege = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_a } }
        }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w10: the Jalayirids are not there" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w10_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w10 is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w10 is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
}
oe_ilk_test_p12 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    oe_ilk_test_tim_build = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TIM oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes }
        # Baghdad goes to the stand-in Timurids (the Jalayirids' capital is moved first), unless Timur fights them already
        if = { limit = { NOT = { location:baghdad = { owner ?= c:TIM } } c:TIM = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = global_var:oe_ilk_jal } } } if = {
            limit = { location:baghdad = { has_owner = yes has_siege = no owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { this = c:TIM } } } }
            location:baghdad = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_o } }
            if = {
                limit = { location:baghdad = { is_capital = yes } }
                scope:oe_ilk_tp_o = {
                    random_owned_location = { limit = { NOT = { this = location:baghdad } has_siege = no } save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_cap_baghdad }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_baghdad } set_capital = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_baghdad }
                }
            }
            location:baghdad = { if = { limit = { is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TIM } }
        } }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w12: Timur's state or the Jalayirids are not there" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w12_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w12 is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w12 is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
}
oe_ilk_test_p13 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ilk_ott_ok = yes c:TUR = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } country_exists = c:ERE c:ERE = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ERE c:ERE = { is_subject = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no } } } c:ERE = { overlord = { cancel_subject = c:ERE } } }
        c:TUR = {
            save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_c
            while = {
                count = 30
                if = { limit = { army_size < oe_ilk_ere_army_x3 } capital = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_c } } }
            }
        }
        # a border with the Ottomans or one of their subjects: one of Eretna's locations goes to the Ottomans
        if = {
            limit = { c:ERE = { NOT = { is_neighbor_of = c:TUR } NOT = { any_neighbor_country = { is_subject_of = c:TUR } } } }
            c:ERE = { random_owned_location = { limit = { is_capital = no has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
        }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w13: Eretna or the Ottomans are not there, or the Ottoman part is off" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w13_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w13 is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w13 is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
}
oe_ilk_test_p14 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    oe_ilk_test_tim_build = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TIM }
        # a: Sivas becomes Timur's (Eretna's capital is moved first)
        if = { limit = { NOT = { location:sivas = { owner ?= c:TIM } } } if = {
            limit = { location:sivas = { has_owner = yes has_siege = no owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { this = c:TIM } } } }
            location:sivas = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_o } }
            if = {
                limit = { location:sivas = { is_capital = yes } }
                scope:oe_ilk_tp_o = {
                    random_owned_location = { limit = { NOT = { this = location:sivas } has_siege = no } save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_cap_sivas }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_sivas } set_capital = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_sivas }
                }
            }
            location:sivas = { if = { limit = { is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TIM } }
        } }
        # c: the Jalayirids lose Baghdad, unless the Black Sheep are gone or at war with Timur already
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes location:baghdad = { owner ?= global_var:oe_ilk_jal } country_exists = c:QAR c:QAR = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TIM } } }
            if = {
                limit = { location:baghdad = { has_owner = yes has_siege = no owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { this = c:TIM } } } }
                location:baghdad = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_o } }
                if = {
                    limit = { location:baghdad = { is_capital = yes } }
                    scope:oe_ilk_tp_o = {
                        random_owned_location = { limit = { NOT = { this = location:baghdad } has_siege = no } save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_cap_baghdad }
                        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_baghdad } set_capital = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_baghdad }
                    }
                }
                location:baghdad = { if = { limit = { is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TIM } }
            }
        }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w14: Timur's state could not be built" }
    debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w14: part b needs a war of Timur's state on Egypt (ilk3p14w)"
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w14a_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w14a is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w14a is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w14b_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w14b is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w14b is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
