oe_ilk_test_p14w = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:TIM country_exists = c:MAM
            c:TIM = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:MAM } NOT = { any_country_that_can_be_called_offensively = { oe_ilk_barred = yes } } }
            c:MAM = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { any_country_that_can_be_called_defensively = { oe_ilk_barred = yes } } }
        }
        c:TIM = { declare_war = c:MAM }
        if = { limit = { c:TIM = { is_at_war_with = c:MAM } } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w14 b: Timur's state is at war with Egypt" }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w14 b: the engine declared no war" }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w14 b: Timur's state or Egypt is missing, at war already, or a player or the imperial bloc could be called in" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w14b_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w14b is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w14b is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }

oe_ilk_test_p16 = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:chg_timur_lame_borjigin }
	    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
	    oe_ilk_test_tim_build = yes
	    # Timur himself dies (w16 comes after his death): from now on nothing that needs him alive can be tried in this game
	    if = { limit = { character:chg_timur_lame_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes } } kill_character = { target = character:chg_timur_lame_borjigin } }
	    if = {
	        limit = { country_exists = c:TIM }
	        # the Black Sheep there: they become Timur's vassal (the "freed" branch); gone: two home locations to Timur (the
	        # "rebuilt" branch)
	        if = {
	            limit = { country_exists = c:QAR }
	            if = {
	                limit = { c:QAR = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { is_subject_of = c:TIM } } }
	                if = { limit = { country_exists = c:QAR c:QAR = { is_subject = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no } } } c:QAR = { overlord = { cancel_subject = c:QAR } } }
	                c:QAR = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TIM type = subject_type:vassal } }
	            }
	        }
	        else = {
	            if = {
	                limit = { location:ercis = { has_owner = yes has_siege = no owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { this = c:TIM } } } }
	                location:ercis = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_o } }
	                if = {
	                    limit = { location:ercis = { is_capital = yes } }
	                    scope:oe_ilk_tp_o = {
	                        random_owned_location = { limit = { NOT = { this = location:ercis } has_siege = no } save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_cap_ercis }
	                        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_ercis } set_capital = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_ercis }
	                    }
	                }
	                location:ercis = { if = { limit = { is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TIM } }
	            }
	            if = {
	                limit = { location:bargiri = { has_owner = yes has_siege = no owner = { oe_ilk_ai = yes NOT = { this = c:TIM } } } }
	                location:bargiri = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_o } }
	                if = {
	                    limit = { location:bargiri = { is_capital = yes } }
	                    scope:oe_ilk_tp_o = {
	                        random_owned_location = { limit = { NOT = { this = location:bargiri } has_siege = no } save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_cap_bargiri }
	                        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_bargiri } set_capital = scope:oe_ilk_tp_cap_bargiri }
	                    }
	                }
	                location:bargiri = { if = { limit = { is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TIM } }
	            }
	        }
	    }
	    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w16: Timur's state could not be built" }
	    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w16_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w16 is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
	    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w16 is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
	}

	    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w20 is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
	}
}
oe_ilk_test_p21 = {
    oe_ilk_test_begin = yes
    oe_ilk_test_tim_build = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TIM }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:KRT c:KRT = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KRT c:KRT = { is_subject = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no NOT = { tag = GRG } } } } c:KRT = { overlord = { cancel_subject = c:KRT } } }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { c:TIM = { is_neighbor_of = c:KRT } } c:KRT = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
                c:TIM = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_a }
                c:KRT = { random_owned_location = { limit = { is_capital = no has_siege = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_a } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:SRB c:SRB = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRB c:SRB = { is_subject = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = yes oe_heg_byz_bloc = no NOT = { tag = GRG } } } } c:SRB = { overlord = { cancel_subject = c:SRB } } }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { c:TIM = { is_neighbor_of = c:SRB } } c:SRB = { oe_ilk_ai = yes } }
                c:TIM = { save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_a }
                c:SRB = { random_owned_location = { limit = { is_capital = no has_siege = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_a } }
            }
        }
        c:TIM = {
            save_scope_as = oe_ilk_tp_c
            while = {
                count = 30
                if = { limit = { OR = { army_size < oe_ilk_krt_army_x3 army_size < oe_ilk_srb_army_x3 } } capital = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_steppe_horse_archers owner = scope:oe_ilk_tp_c } } }
            }
        }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep w21: Timur's state could not be built" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w21k_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w21k is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w21k is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w21s_ok = yes } debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w21s is ready; press its button (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ilk test prep: w21s is still not ready (ready2 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2')|0] ready2b [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready2b')|0] ready3 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_ready3')|0] tim [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ilk_rd_tim')|0])" }
}
